📖 How to use

  1. Enter the credit line limit, drawn amount and interest rate.

  3. Read both phase payments instantly.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a draw period vs repayment period?

A HELOC has two phases: a draw period (often 10 years) where you pay interest only, then a repayment period (often 20 years) where the balance amortizes like a loan.

How is the draw-phase payment calculated?

Draw-phase payment = drawn balance × monthly interest rate. No principal is repaid during this phase.

Is my rate fixed on a HELOC?

Most HELOCs have variable rates that can rise. This calculator uses a fixed rate you enter, so real payments could be higher.
